text: Human judges reached 88% accuracy with debate versus 60% naive; consultancy 78%; debate beats consultancy significantly (p = 0.001 static, p = 0.048 interactive). Rejecting judgements below 75% confidence keeps 65% of questions at 94% accuracy (Insight 8). Main human experiments used GPT-4-Turbo best-of-16 debaters.
